audits.name: Library Load & Performance Time
audits.description: Check what external libraries are loaded and measure their DNS, TCP, and load times.

audits.name: Console Errors Logging
audits.description: Identify and log native page console errors for debugging silent failures.

audits.name: Cookie Auditing
audits.description: Check for consent cookies, functional cookies, and flag third-party tracking cookies.

audits.name: CDP/Integration Data Flow
audits.description: Verify if data is sent to CDPs/CRMs (e.g., HubSpot) when marketing consent is denied.

audits.name: Ad Tracking Flow Verification
audits.description: Verify if ads/tracking pixels fire when consent is blocked.

audits.name: Zero-Cookie Load Test
audits.description: Check if non-essential cookies are dropped before the user interacts with the consent banner.

audits.name: Local/Session Storage Sneaking
audits.description: Audit localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB for identifiers bypassing cookie blockers.

audits.name: Third-Party Domain Requests
audits.description: Tally up all external domains the website communicates with to identify uncontrolled tracking.

audits.name: Core Web Vitals (CWV)
audits.description: Measure real-time LCP, CLS, and INP metrics.

audits.name: Asset Size Warnings
audits.description: Flag uncompressed scripts, missing gzip/brotli headers, or oversized images (> 1MB).

audits.name: Render-Blocking Resources
audits.description: Identify CSS or JS files in the <head> that delay the first contentful paint.

audits.name: Mixed Content Warnings
audits.description: Flag if a secure site (HTTPS) is attempting to load insecure HTTP resources.

audits.name: Missing Essential Meta Tags
audits.description: Audit the page for missing viewport, canonical links, or Open Graph tags.

audits.name: PII Leakage Detection
audits.description: Detect plaintext or hashed PII (email, phone, name) in cookies or outgoing network payloads.

audits.name: Third-Party iFrame Audits
audits.description: Check if embedded iframes drop trackers or cookies while bypassing parent site consent rules.

audits.name: Tag Schema Validation
audits.description: Verify network payloads match expected event schemas for platforms like TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Bing.

audits.name: Event Duplication
audits.description: Check if multiple identical tracking events fire off a single user action skewing metrics.

audits.name: Unused or Dead Scripts
audits.description: Flag external libraries that are loaded but never executed, or those that return 4xx/5xx network errors.

audits.name: Synchronous Script Blocking
audits.description: Detect if third-party scripts are loaded synchronously without async or defer attributes.

audits.name: Exposed API Keys
audits.description: Scan the DOM and network requests for hardcoded or exposed keys (e.g., Stripe publishable keys, HubSpot tokens).

audits.name: Console Warnings Logging
audits.description: Identify and log deprecation notices or library warnings.
